metadata.question: Does the active fire presence in La Palma, Spain decrease in July 17-18, 2023 compared to July 15-16, 2023?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use FIRMS/MODIS active fire product (MODIS_006_MOD14A1 or VIIRS) or thermal bands from Landsat/Sentinel - Best option: FIRMS MODIS (MOD14A1) or VIIRS (VNP14IMGML) for daily active fire detection - Location: La Palma, Spain (Canary Islands) - need to define geometry - Dates: July 15-16, 2023 vs July 17-18, 2023 2. Masking strategy: - No cloud masking needed for fire products - Use FireMask band or MaxFRP (Fire Radiative Power) to detect active fires - Count fire pixels or sum fire radiative power 3. Logic: - Valid Zero (fires decreased to 0) = Answer A (Yes, decreased) - Both periods have 0 fires = Answer B (No change/No decrease) - If one period has no data = C1 - If calculation fails = C3 ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define La Palma, Spain geometry (Canary Islands) const laPalma = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[-18.0, 28.9], [-18.0, 28.5], [-17.7, 28.5], [-17.7, 28.9], [-18.0, 28.9]] ]); // 2. Define time periods const period1Start = '2023-07-15'; const period1End = '2023-07-17'; const period2Start = '2023-07-17'; const period2End = '2023-07-19'; // 3. Load FIRMS MODIS/VIIRS fire data let col1 = ee.ImageCollection('FIRMS') .filterBounds(laPalma) .filterDate(period1Start, period1End); let col2 = ee.ImageCollection('FIRMS') .filterBounds(laPalma) .filterDate(period2Start, period2End); const size1 = col1.size().getInfo(); const size2 = col2.size().getInfo(); // Try MODIS Thermal Anomalies if FIRMS not available if (size1 === 0 && size2 === 0) { col1 = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD14A1') .filterBounds(laPalma) .filterDate(period1Start, period1End); col2 = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD14A1') .filterBounds(laPalma) .filterDate(period2Start, period2End); } const finalSize1 = col1.size().getInfo(); const finalSize2 = col2.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Period 1 (Jul 15-16): ${finalSize1} images`); console.log(`Period 2 (Jul 17-18): ${finalSize2} images`); if (finalSize1 === 0 || finalSize2 === 0) { console.log('No fire data available for one or both periods'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 4. Calculate fire metrics (use MaxFRP - Fire Radiative Power) const img1 = col1.select('MaxFRP').max(); const img2 = col2.select('MaxFRP').max(); // Count fire pixels and sum FRP const stats1 = img1.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum().combine({reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true}), geometry: laPalma, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const stats2 = img2.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum().combine({reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true}), geometry: laPalma, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const frp1 = stats1.get('MaxFRP_sum').getInfo(); const count1 = stats1.get('MaxFRP_count').getInfo(); const frp2 = stats2.get('MaxFRP_sum').getInfo(); const count2 = stats2.get('MaxFRP_count').getInfo(); console.log(`Jul 15-16: FRP=${frp1}, Fire pixels=${count1}`); console.log(`Jul 17-18: FRP=${frp2}, Fire pixels=${count2}`); // 5. Validation and answer if (frp1 === null || frp2 === null) { console.log('Calculation failed'); console.log('C3'); return; } // Check if fires decreased if (frp2 < frp1 || count2 < count1) { console.log('Fire presence decreased'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('Fire presence did not decrease'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
